name: Group Work Day
description: Teams pick roles, then check off a shared to-do list, live progress on the projector. Swap in your own tasks for any work day.
when: When groups work the same task list and you want to see who is where without walking the room.

intro.message:
GROUP WORK DAY!

You're about to be split into groups, and everyone gets a job.

Every group has the same checklist on their devices, check tasks off as your group finishes them, and watch the progress board up here.

worktime.prompt: Work through today's tasks with your group. Tagged tasks belong to a job, but the whole group backs each other up.
items: Introduce yourselves and agree on a team name
Facilitator: Make sure everyone has said their name and one interest
Find three things everyone in your group has in common (going to this school doesn't count)
Recorder: Write your group's three common things where everyone can see them
Agree on one dream field trip, a destination and the reason
Timekeeper: Give a two-minutes-left warning before the pitch planning ends
Plan a 30-second pitch for your field trip and pick who delivers it
Final check: mark this when every member has spoken at least twice

end.message: That's Group Work Day! Swap in your own tasks and jobs for any lab, stations, or project session.
